rule: Before marking product_briefs[].handoff_status as ready, the Product Adapter must run these checks.

checks.requirement: generation_prompt includes subject, style/medium, composition guidance, and aspect ratio or format intent
brief preserves the collection visual_grammar and does not contradict it
listing_logic.primary_keywords contains at least 5 strategic keywords
listing_logic.bundle_role is one of hero, support, entry
risks and production_risks are specific, actionable, and non-generic

failure_rule: If one or more checks fail, set handoff_status to needs_revision and explain failures in quality_gate_notes.
